text:
incident-bot: (post-incident) Follow-ups requested for AUDIT-EXPORT backlog incident: add DLQ alerting, improve connector error classification, update runbook. Please drop owners + ETA here.

Sean Gallagher: quick thread to capture next steps while it’s fresh. During the Splunk HEC 5xx window we had: retry storms, backlog grew, and we didn’t page until customer pinged Support. We need DLQ signal + better error bucketing so we can auto-suggest mitigations (pause dest / reduce batch / flip off ACK). :thumbsup:

Rafael Mendes: +1. Also the runbook didn’t cover the “partial batch 5xx -> retried forever” nuance. It has generic backlog drain steps but not “when to pause a single destination vs global”. I can take runbook updates.

Allison Grant: For DLQ alert: we already emit `audit_exporter_dlq_written_total` and `audit_exporter_dlq_depth` in staging, but prod alert rules don’t include them yet. We should page on growth rate, not absolute depth (depth can be non-zero during controlled replays).

Aisha Bello: I can wire the alert + dashboard panel. Proposal:
- Warning: `rate(audit_exporter_dlq_written_total[5m]) > 0` for 10m (ticket)
- Page: `rate(audit_exporter_dlq_written_total[5m]) > 2` for 10m OR `audit_exporter_dlq_depth > 500` for 15m
We can scope per-destination label so it points at Splunk/Datadog/S3.

Sean Gallagher: make the page condition slightly higher to avoid noise when we intentionally DLQ poison pills? maybe page on sustained rate AND % of processed.

Allison Grant: yeah, better: page on `dlq_write / processed` ratio. Do we have `audit_exporter_events_processed_total` with same labels?

Benji Okafor: processed metric exists but label set is slightly different (destination_id vs destination_type). We can align; right now processed is per worker + destination_type only. I can open a small PR to normalize labels so SRE can alert on ratio per destination_id.

Rafael Mendes: error classification: today everything non-2xx basically shows up as `connector_error`. We need buckets:
- auth (401/403)
- throttling (429)
- upstream_unavailable (5xx, timeouts)
- schema/validation (400, 422)
- ack_timeout (HEC ACK enabled but no ack)
And the runbook should map each class to “what to do next”.

Sean Gallagher: + add “retryable vs non-retryable” explicitly. The incident was painful bc 5xx was retryable, but we had no circuit breaker so we hammered and created lag for everyone.

Benji Okafor: on classification: exporter has an enum internally but we’re not exporting it as a label (we drop it into a string log field only). I’ll add `error_class` label on `audit_exporter_connector_failures_total` + include last_error_class in the health endpoint payload to Console.

Allison Grant: careful w/ label cardinality. `destination_id` + `error_class` is fine, but don’t add raw error codes/messages. Please keep it to fixed set.

Aisha Bello: runbook link for edits: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGSRE/audit-export-backlog-drain-replay (section “Connector failures” needs expansion). I’ll add a small “DLQ triage” section once alert is in.

Rafael Mendes: I’ll update runbook with:
1) Decision tree: pause destination vs keep retrying
2) How to identify poison pill vs upstream outage (DLQ, error_class)
3) Replay caveats + dedupe reminder
4) Where to find per-destination backlog / last_success
ETA EOD tomorrow.

Sean Gallagher: Action items (please react :white_check_mark: if you own):
- DLQ alerts + dashboard panel (Aisha)
- Normalize metric labels for processed vs DLQ + add error_class label (Benji)
- Runbook updates (Rafael)
- I’ll follow up w/ Platform on circuit breaker defaults + backoff caps; we should ensure retry storms can’t starve primary API. (ties to ENG-13932)

Aisha Bello: :white_check_mark: I’ll put up PR in observability-pack today, target merge tomorrow morning. Will start w/ warning+page on DLQ write rate, and add ratio once Benji’s metrics are consistent.

Benji Okafor: :white_check_mark: I’ll file a small PR to exporter + control plane health payload. ETA tomorrow. Will also add a note to keep error_class label fixed list.

Rafael Mendes: :white_check_mark: runbook edits tomorrow + will ping Sean for review before publishing.

Sean Gallagher: awesome. once these land, let’s do a 15m review to confirm paging behavior (esp during planned replays) and update on-call notes. :thumbsup:
